violation_type.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Children's Names and Ages (26 TAC §744.1203(3))
violation_type.short_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Children's Names and Ages
violation_type.typical_finding: A caregiver in charge of a group of children 7yrs. to 11 yrs. old was not aware of the ages of the children in care.

finding_variants.text: A caregiver in charge of a group of children 7yrs. to 11 yrs. old was not aware of the ages of the children in care.
At the time of the inspection, a caregiver was observed telling children she forgot their names and was asking the children for a reminder.
The program director responsible for a group of children 7yrs. to 11 yrs. old was not aware of the ages of the children in care.
The caregiver in the large room did not know the children names and ages during the inspection.
The enrichment caregivers caring for children did not have information on the group of children they were caring for.

The Director responsible for a group of 7 children did not know the ages of the children they were currently responsible for.     A caregiver responsible for a group of 11 children did not know the ages of the children they were responsible for.     Also, two caregivers responsible for a group of 13 children did not know the ages of the children they were responsible for.
